text_block_list.text:
Falcon? She isn't here. She left about one
hour and thirty-five minutes
ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A day has passed since I recommended
that Smart Falcon run on dirt
courses.
Wanting to talk to her again, I've come to
her dorm in search
of her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My apologies for the late introduction. I'm
Eishin Flash, Smart
Falcon's roommate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Are you... Falcon's trainer? If it's urgent,
contacting her smartphone is
the surest
way to get a hold of her.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Although I can't guarantee that she'll
check her phone. She might've
turned it
off by now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka was amazing! I knew she
was good, but I didn't think
she'd win by
that much!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we caught the whole thing in
person! I can't wait to see
Suzuka take
center stage for the winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My search for Smart Falcon leads me to
the racetrack. The stadium's
filled to the
brim with excited onlookers waiting for the
winning
concert to begin.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! This is so exciting! ☆ Go, Suzuka!
You can do it! I believe in
you!

text_block_list.name: Wild Crowd
text_block_list.text: YEAHHH! SUZUKAAA!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The concert begins. Everyone's eyes are
glued to the incredible
performance that
follows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Silence Suzuka's voice isn't the
loudest, the joy in it is
palpable—a joy
shared by all her cheering fans.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! Sniffle... Suzukaaa! You're the best! Watching you run makes me feel like I can do anything! I'll keep working hard, just like you do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, I find myself captivated like
everyone else. Then my
eyes drift over to
Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are also locked onto the stage,
but something about her
gaze seems...
different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the concert ends, I look for Smart
Falcon, but she's already
gone. It's
possible that she left for the dorm, but I
suspect otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everybody! I'm Falco! That was a great
concert, wasn't it? ☆
Suzuka never fails to
impress!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But don't go anywhere yet! I'll give you a
fantastic performance too!
All I ask is that
you remember my name! ☆ With that said,
let's get
started! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My suspicions are confirmed when I spot
Smart Falcon performing by
the riverside.
Maybe this is just a plan to attract an
audience still
riding their concert high,
but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, she looks like an Umamusume too.
Do you know her?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, never seen her. Maybe she hasn't
made her debut yet? Anyway,
wasn't
Suzuka's concert great? My favorite part
was when she—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... How was that, everybody?! It's my dream to one day perform on a major stage! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: One day...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I... wonder when that'll be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like anybody here would
know. Time to head—oh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I... I've always loved idols a lot, ever since I
was little. They're so cute,
and they smile
so bright that they light up any stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I kept telling myself that I'd be an idol one
day too. But that dream
changed just a
little when I saw my first race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I went because I'd heard that Umamusume
sing and dance just like
idols do, in
addition to race. It was such a strange
concept to me that
I had to find out more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing everybody running their hardest, I
couldn't take my eyes off
the
racetrack—not even for a second!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But what was even more exciting was the
concert that came after!
When the
spotlight hit them, everyone shone twice
as bright as they
did on the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought to myself, "That's what I want!"
Umamusume shine their
brightest while
running, and their winning concerts are the
cherry on
top!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's when I decided to become an
Umadol! I wanted to light up the
world
like they did—no, even more than that! I
wanted to become a
shining beacon of
hope!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like... the way Suzuka did today,
taking first place and
performing center
stage...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a shining star just like her! I
want to be an Umadol that
moves the
hearts of all who watch me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I keep working hard, one day my
dream'll come true. Or at least,
that's what
I keep telling myself...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I don't mean to say that I feel like
giving up! Let me make it
clear—I still
dream of becoming a world-class Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's just that... that dream feels so distant
today. Suzuka was so
amazing, it's hard to
think I could follow in her footsteps...
Haha...
ha...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know... I actually knew as much
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was admitted here, my
teachers have all suggested that I
run on
dirt courses. They say it suits me better.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But... I can't become a top Umadol running
in dirt races. You know
what I mean, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. If I choose to run in dirt races, I'll
never perform on a big
stage like Suzuka
did today.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The fans like turf races because that's
where all the superstars are. It's
only fair
that the runners who win there are
considered the best.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I could run on dirt courses, win races,
and be the star of those
winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But... that's not what I want! I don't want to be the lead of just any concert! My dream is to become a top Umadol and make it big on the greatest stages!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to give up on my dreams just
'cause I'm "better suited" for
something
else! There's no room for compromise! I
can't do it! I won't
do it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You probably think I'm being ridiculous.
But I don't care! I'll keep
racing on turf
courses in hopes of one day achieving my
dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand her reason for wanting to run
in turf races. I also agree
that it's important
to dream big, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to think that dirt racing is some
kind of second-rate
category, and that's
just not right. In order to help her realize
that...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, uh... As long as you're the one
asking for permission, they'd
probably be
okay with it, but... why?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay. I still don't get why, but I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But in exchange, you have to do one thing
for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'd like it if you called me Falco, not
Falcon! ☆ It sounds cuter that
way!
